# roborev

> roborev is local, continuous code review for the agentic loop: an
> open-source review daemon for teams that ship with coding agents. A git
> hook reviews every commit in the background using the agents you already
> run (Codex, Claude Code, Gemini, Copilot, and more), keeps findings in a
> ledger until they are addressed, and feeds them back into the agent session
> so fixes happen while context is fresh. It also reviews GitHub and GitLab
> pull requests with multi-agent panels and syncs review history across
> machines.

The product and guide pages have exact Markdown twins; documentation pages are
served as HTML with Markdown twins alongside. Markdown versions are canonical
for machine readers: every rendered docs page at /docs/<page>/ is also served
as raw Markdown at /docs/<page>.md.

## Product

- [Product overview](https://roborev.io/index.md): what roborev is; the
  review loop, the ledger, agents, panels, CI, team visibility, ownership
- [The guide](https://roborev.io/guide.md): a ten-stop tour from `roborev
  init` to CI panels and team-wide review history

## Docs

- [Documentation index](https://roborev.io/docs/index.md): install,
  quickstart, and the documentation map
- [Quick start](https://roborev.io/docs/quickstart.md): install, initialize a
  repo, read reviews, act on findings
- [Installation](https://roborev.io/docs/installation.md): every install
  method, upgrades, and uninstall
- [Changelog](https://roborev.io/docs/changelog.md): release history
- [Post-commit reviews](https://roborev.io/docs/automation/post-commit-reviews.md):
  the two automation layers, batching, and hands-off setup
- [Agent Hook](https://roborev.io/docs/agent-hook.md): bring open findings
  back into Claude Code, Codex, Copilot, Cursor, Droid, Gemini, Hermes, and
  Qwen sessions
- [Review event hooks](https://roborev.io/docs/guides/hooks.md): run shell
  commands, notifications, and the built-in kata and beads integrations on
  review events
- [CLI commands](https://roborev.io/docs/commands.md): every command and flag
- [Terminal UI](https://roborev.io/docs/integrations/tui.md): the review queue
  in the terminal
- [Browser UI](https://roborev.io/docs/web-ui.md): the review workspace and
  analytics served by the daemon
- [Configuration](https://roborev.io/docs/configuration.md): global and
  per-repo settings, guidelines, agents, models, panels, experiments
- [Supported agents](https://roborev.io/docs/agents.md): agent detection,
  selection, and install commands
- [GitHub integration](https://roborev.io/docs/integrations/github.md): CI
  poller, GitHub App auth, PR comments and checks
- [GitLab integration](https://roborev.io/docs/integrations/gitlab.md): merge
  request reviews and notes
- [Reviewing code](https://roborev.io/docs/guides/reviewing-code.md): commits,
  ranges, branches, dirty trees, review types
- [Responding to reviews](https://roborev.io/docs/guides/responding-to-reviews.md):
  comments, closing, and the review ledger
- [Agent skills](https://roborev.io/docs/guides/agent-skills.md): the
  `/roborev-fix`, `/roborev-refine`, and review skills
- [Code analysis and refactoring](https://roborev.io/docs/guides/assisted-refactoring.md):
  `roborev analyze` types and `roborev fix`
- [Auto-fix with refine](https://roborev.io/docs/guides/auto-fixing.md): the
  fix, re-review, repeat loop
- [Repository management](https://roborev.io/docs/guides/repository-management.md):
  registering repos, worktrees, exclusions
- [Background tasks](https://roborev.io/docs/advanced/background-tasks.md):
  `roborev run` and task jobs
- [Subagent review panels](https://roborev.io/docs/advanced/subagent-review-panels.md):
  multi-reviewer panels with synthesis
- [Custom review types](https://roborev.io/docs/advanced/custom-review-types.md):
  template-driven review rubrics
- [Custom tasks and agentic mode](https://roborev.io/docs/advanced/custom-tasks.md):
  agentic reviews and custom prompts
- [Agent Client Protocol](https://roborev.io/docs/advanced/acp.md): ACP
  adapters for additional agents
- [PostgreSQL sync](https://roborev.io/docs/advanced/postgres-sync.md):
  multi-machine review history
- [Streaming and daemon API](https://roborev.io/docs/advanced/streaming.md):
  HTTP API and server-sent events
- [Kata integration](https://roborev.io/docs/integrations/kata.md): task
  context in prompts and findings filed as kata issues
- [Claude Chic integration](https://roborev.io/docs/integrations/claudechic.md):
  review sidebar in Claude Chic
- [Troubleshooting](https://roborev.io/docs/guides/troubleshooting.md): daemon,
  hooks, agents, and quota problems
- [Development](https://roborev.io/docs/development.md): building, testing,
  and contributing
